summary:
Zscaler最新季度營收與獲利均優於市場預期，展現強勁的雲端資安業務動能。
• 季度營收年增24.88%至8.982億美元
• 每股盈餘（EPS）達1.19美元，優於市場預期的1.09美元
• 核心雲端資安平台需求維持穩健成長
• 獲利能力持續改善，營運效率提升
ai_view:
觀點：財報優於預期展現基本面韌性，對中短期股價具正面支撐。建議追蹤後續大型企業客戶拓展速度與帳單金額（Billings）成長表現。

需留意：企業IT預算審查趨嚴可能拉長銷售週期；雲端資安市場競爭激烈，面臨來自傳統與新創巨頭的壓力

summary_en:
Zscaler delivered a strong quarterly performance with revenue and earnings topping estimates, driven by robust cloud security momentum.
• Quarterly revenue grew 24.88% year-over-year to $898.2 million
• EPS of $1.19 beat the estimated $1.09
• Strong and steady demand for core cloud security platforms
• Continued improvement in profitability and operating efficiency

需留意：企業IT預算審查趨嚴可能拉長銷售週期；雲端資安市場競爭激烈，面臨來自傳統與新創巨頭的壓力
ai_view_en:
View: Strong earnings demonstrate fundamental resilience, providing positive support for near- to mid-term share prices. Track enterprise customer acquisition pace and billings growth.

Watch：Tighter enterprise IT budget scrutiny could lengthen sales cycles; Intense competition in the cloud security market from legacy and emerging giants
